basis: Authored productivity and billable trade-rate scenarios; not contractor quotes or BLS productivity data

phases.notes: Operator and ground worker labor; machine hire/fuel/transport priced separately. Assumes no blasting/dewatering.
Concrete material in purchasing table; pump/forms hire separate. Inspection and release allowance included in waiting time.

phases.phase: Retaining-wall forms, steel, pour and strip
phases.notes: Site-engineered retaining shell. Waiting is a schedule allowance, not approval to strip/load/backfill at a particular concrete age; engineer sets release.

phases.phase: Underslab prep, service coordination and slab
phases.notes: Includes underfloor pipe/sleeve installation labor; plumbing/electrical rough rows exclude this work. Cure/inspection waiting allowance.
Membrane, protection, drain and outlet work; material package counted separately. Inspection before concealment.

phases.phase: Roof framing, transfer supports and deck
phases.notes: Engineered joist/transfer design required. Lift/crane hire separate; trade labor included here.

phases.phase: Roof insulation, membrane, flashing and gutters
phases.notes: Dry-in and envelope inspection allowance; materials priced once in purchasing table.

phases.phase: Interior partition framing and door blocking
phases.notes: Owner-assisted option substitutes owner effort only here and in finish phases; structural roof/retaining work remains hired.
Weather flashing and escape-opening verification; no window material double count.
House supply/waste lines and tests only; excludes septic/well. Underslab labor is in slab phase.
House panel, branch circuits and existing-power interface checks. No PV/battery/generator purchase or utility extension.
Ducts, equipment installation and rough connections; equipment supply counted in materials.
Waiting window only, not a fee or another bill for trade hours; normal corrections covered in phase ranges.
Interior finish labor only. Drying time is separate from person-hours.

phases.phase: Cabinets, counters, flooring and interior doors
phases.notes: Fit-out labor; cabinetry, flooring and door materials already priced. Specialized countertop fabrication may remain subcontracted in owner option.
Fixtures/trim labor, separate from rough-in hours; supply in materials.
Trim and testing; no new off-grid generation/storage equipment.
Mechanical commissioning labor; equipment cost remains in materials.

phases.phase: Engineered backfill and immediate final grading
phases.notes: Roof diaphragm/retaining system and waterproofing must be released before backfill. Engineer's sequence governs; machines priced separately.

phases.phase: Punch list, cleanup and final inspections
phases.notes: Multitrade closeout and cleanup, excluding duplicate HVAC balancing/trim labor. Inspection scheduling risk is also in overall buffer.

equipment.basis: Machine costs only; operator/ground labor is in excavation and backfill phases. Import/export trucking beyond ordinary immediate works requires a quote.

equipment.item: Concrete forms hire/consumables, pump and roof lift/crane hire
equipment.basis: Equipment/formwork package only; placement, rigging and carpentry labor are in corresponding phases. Not a supplier quote.
